purpose: Collect qualified prospective evidence to compare baseline stagnation exits with structural trend continuation.
Keep frozen JEV gate/model identities and terminal-veto evidence cohorts distinct.
Improve read-only analysis without changing trading rules or manufacturing historical evidence.

controller.release_protocol: Exact manifest; venue/local flat preflight; graceful stop and empty executor groups; second flat gate; same-binding manage-only recovery; ACTIVE request. No forced close or manually submitted test trade.

candidate_qa.scope: Exact staged controller package, not whole repository and not live profitability acceptance.

initial_run.cause: New entry-context contract tests imported the offline report helper, which was not yet included in the candidate package.
initial_run.resolution: Include the compatible offline report module as the ninth source file and rerun all 23 suites.

cross_package_qa.scope: Real isolated inventory, market adapter, exit capture and PG research-view projection; cross-package shadow reader. No exchange settlement/profitability claim.
cross_package_qa.initial_fixture_issue: The lifecycle fixture opens at virtual time 3; mixing this with current wall time exceeded the existing ten-year holding bound. Corrected the fixture's virtual clock without changing runtime validation.

final_offline_report_regression.scope: Targeted recheck after withdrawing query experiments; overlaps candidate QA, not additional distinct coverage.

post_release_http_checks.external_note: Authentication challenge only; no authenticated external browser-session acceptance claimed.

offline_query_performance.scope: Offline JEV effectiveness full-day read for 2026-11-12; not the scheduled Telegram daily review or order path.
offline_query_performance.observed: Original full-day query exceeded its timeout. Index-friendly, hourly and materialized alternatives still timed out in actual bounded read-only probes.
offline_query_performance.resolution: Retain the original query; ship only separately verified cohort and identity fixes. Do not deploy unproven query complexity or claim the report completed.

limitations: Old exits do not gain invented receipt times or native quantity evidence.
Stale inventory or partial optional history remains explicitly UNKNOWN/PARTIAL.
A larger response in the existing request is not proof of zero added latency.
Terminal JEV vetoes have no fresh account recheck and must not be treated as executable comparison candidates.
Missing historic gate/model identities are excluded from matched comparison, not grouped into one treatment.
Actual structural runner execution and soft-versus-hard gate experiments remain future work.
The offline full-day JEV effectiveness read still exceeds its original three-second statement timeout; this release does not fix that performance issue.
No new natural stagnation exit has yet been accepted as a complete prospective sample; do not substitute isolated QA for this live observation.
No demonstrated profitability improvement from this correctness and evidence release.
